reason: If the class teacher is assigning it as homework and checking it in class, my child is doing it anyway, and ₹249 a month is nothing next to what I pay for tuition. If it is tied to the school's own chapters and the teacher is watching, it will show up in the unit test marks, so I will lock in the pilot price.
objection: My child already has tuition after school; I am not sure 20 more minutes on an app moves the exam marks or rank, or whether it just repeats what the tuition teacher already covers.
would_change_my_mind: If the school stops making it part of homework after the pilot, or my relative's child's marks in the next unit test show no change, I would drop it and keep only the tuition.
